name: human-distiller
description: Delegate reversible choices within a configured risk ceiling using a local preference profile.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate choices within your risk ceiling.
interface.longDescription: Human Distiller learns explicit preferences, delegates only choices within a configured risk ceiling and fixed safety boundary, and detects possible preference drift while keeping personal data local.
defaultPrompt: Use $human-distiller init to configure delegated decisions.
Use $human-distiller uninstall to remove its adapters safely.
